products.name: Testing Accommodations: Workbook + Examples
products.description: Walk away with a complete accommodations request you can adapt to your own diagnosis. Inside: her full example application for USMLE Step 1, 2 and 3, a template for your personal statement, a template to hand your health professional for the supporting letter, the most requested DSM-5 criteria for ADHD, MDD, GAD, panic and PTSD, and workbook pages on how to disclose in applications and at school. Bonus: an anonymous personal statement from a medical student with ADHD, MDD and GAD.

products.name: Mock Interview with Dr. Moss
products.description: Practise the interview before it counts. A 30 minute mock plus feedback, one-to-one, with the option to have it recorded so you can watch yourself back. You get constructive feedback on your answers, body language, virtual background and overall presentation, and practice on the hard questions: academic failures, health conditions and disabilities, red flags, gap years and leaves of absence.

products.name: Advising with Dr. Moss, 1 hr
products.description: Leave with a plan for your own situation, not general advice. One hour on failed exams, accommodations, a possible dismissal, a leave of absence, gap years, career pivots in or out of medicine, or applying with red flags or as an IMG.

products.name: Application or Personal Statement Editing
products.description: Get your application read by someone who received over 24 interviews dual-applying to psychiatry and family medicine. One pass across all 10 activities, your 3 most meaningful, publications and impactful experience, with a full analysis of content, voice and tone, custom feedback and proofreading. Turnaround is 48 to 72 hours.

products.name: Advising with Dr. Moss, 30 min
products.description: A focused half hour on one question. Good for a single decision: whether to disclose, how to explain a gap, which programs to signal, or what to do next after a failed exam.

products.name: Residency Mock Interview Course + Workbook
products.description: Prepare for interview season at your own pace. The course covers how residency interviews are scored, what to say about academic failures, health conditions and leaves of absence, and how to present yourself on camera, with a workbook to draft and practise your own answers.
